reviews.name: Michael Rodriguez
reviews.text: I needed security cameras, servers, and all my devices connected at my grocery store (produce world) and Power Tech Group took care of everything. Mick went above and beyond — he made sure the whole setup was done right and didn't leave until everything was working perfectly. Great customer service all around. If you need someone reliable for your business tech needs, these are the guys to call. Highly recommend.

reviews.name: Ava Roper
reviews.text: Mick is a true expert in the security space and did an outstanding job installing IP cameras at my house and small businesses. He was able to wire up the home, and provide a clean install with no issues. The system works great and I can access it on my phone at any time. Couldn't recommend this business more for any security needs!

reviews.text: The company went above and beyond when installing our security cameras. I'm very pleased with the overall experience, and will recommend PowerTech to all my friends that run small businesses.
